turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Attorney Mark Reilly, I represent your grandson in his court case.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, he called me earlier. Is he alright?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's fine, but the bond amount changed. I need $6,500 sent by courier within the hour or the judge may revoke it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, but this must stay between us -- if the prosecutor finds out family was contacted, it could look bad for him. Please don't call the courthouse directly.
